text:
Sea Limited's total revenue in FY2025 was **US$22,938,469 thousand (~US$22.94 billion)**, up from US$16,819,866 thousand in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.95].

This was driven by:
- E-commerce (Shopee): $14,545,894 thousand (63.4% of total)
- Digital Financial Services (Monee): $3,791,641 thousand (16.6% of total)
- Digital Entertainment (Garena): $2,408,765 thousand (10.5% of total)
- Sales of goods: $2,025,408 thousand (8.8% of total)
- Other services: $166,761 thousand (0.7% of total)

[Sea, FY2025, p.95]
